title: Mixed local-nonlocal eigenvalue problems in the Heisenberg group: spectral theory and singular multiplicity
summary: This paper investigates nonlinear eigenvalue problems governed by a family of operators that combine two distinct diffusion mechanisms: a classical local diffusion, which accounts for short-range interactions, and a fractional nonlocal diffusion, which captures long-range effects. The analysis is carried out in the Heisenberg group, a non-Euclidean geometric setting in which motion is constrained to a distinguished set of horizontal directions.
